# Three.js

Vendored from the official npm package `three@0.186.1` (r186).

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.186.1.tgz

`three.module.js` imports `three.core.js` from this directory. Keep both files
from the same package version. The upstream MIT license is retained in `LICENSE`.

Serve the project over HTTP (for example VS Code Live Server). Browser ES modules
do not load through `file://`; the site keeps its CSS room available in that case.
